description: Open the website, locate its chatbot, ask {{question}}, wait for the complete response, and return the chatbot response as an output named answer.

question.description: Value typed where 'question' was used during discovery

answer.example: Soroush Aghajani is a software engineer with a strong background in systems-level development, JVM internals, bytecode engineering, and backend infrastructure. He has experience working on a custom JVM and runtime tooling, focusing on correctness, dynamic execution, and observability. Soroush is skilled in analyzing and instrumenting dynamic execution paths in Java programs, including working with invokedynamic, MethodHandles, lambdas, hidden classes, and runtime-generated classes. He is also proficient in building tools to improve system reliability, observability, and performance. Additionally, he has experience in backend development, specifically with Node.js, Spring Boot, and REST APIs. Soroush holds a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the University of Massachusetts Boston, where he completed an honors thesis and independent studies focused on programming languages and systems. His interests include competitive chess, programming languages, systems design, theory of computation, and building developer tools.
